profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Portfolio: https://savion1300.wixsite.com/website

Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience in tech and gaming. Specializes in Unity, Unreal Engine, C#,
and C++. Proven track record in mobile development, VR/AR, and game design. Expertise in leading
projects, driving innovation, and delivering high-quality software solutions. Strong problem-solving and
collaboration skills. Known for creating immersive gaming experiences and optimizing performance across
platforms.

positions.title: Senior Unity Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained VR applications using Unity and C# for immersive training simulations.

Leveraged OpenXR for cross-platform VR development, targeting devices like Meta Quest, HTC Vive, and Varjo headsets.

Utilized Vive Ultimate Trackers for precise tracking of real-world objects, integrating them seamlessly into the virtual environment.

Collaborated in design and code architecture meetings, providing input on system and feature development for simulation software.

Actively participated in code reviews, ensuring best practices and high-quality standards through the review of pull requests from team members.

Managed version control and collaborative development using GitHub to maintain a structured workflow and integrate changes from multiple contributors.

positions.title: Unity Developer
positions.description:
Contracted by Ursus Inc to work at LSI.

Developed and optimized Unity Software Simulations to support a Navy program under the Sailor 2025 Ready Relevant Learning initiative.

Utilized Unity editor tools to streamline backend processes, ensuring seamless integration with .NET, which serves as the backend for Unity's frontend interface.

Ensured compliance with strict confidentiality requirements, maintaining the security and integrity of all project information.

positions.title: Unity 3d Developer
positions.description:
Developed mobile applications for iOS and Android, enhancing user experience and performance.

Created Unity Editor build scripts to streamline build processes for mobile, WebGL, and Windows projects.

Published mobile builds for the Gunstruction app, ensuring efficient and reliable deployment.

Implemented MQTT for sending and receiving messages, enabling multiplayer functionality.

Utilized web requests to send POST and PUT data to a server, ensuring seamless communication between client and server.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Utilizing Unity and C# to develop training simulations for DOD
contracts.

Use of software configuration management tools such as perforce
and git to handle source control and work as a team.

Create custom editor tools in Unity to fast track development and
documentation for use of such tools

positions.title: Software Tester
positions.description:
• Working with the Unreal Engine on the Rendering and Platform pillars.
• Executing test cases in TestRail, maintain and updating engine test cases.
• Thoroughly investigating and analyzing issues to find root causes.
• Writing clear and concise steps to reproduce bugs in JIRA.
• Communicating and escalating the impact of issues that are block or is critical to testing to developers.
• Utilize Perforce and GitHub to gain access for testing on previous and present builds.

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description:
Isolated and identified bugs and how they occurred within the gaming environment and wrote technical reports using Jira to communicate with Developers for Call of Duty Modern Warfare.

Regression testing on new builds to ensure previous tested functionality is still working. 

Performance test to ensure the product works and to test the limits of the software.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
Taught students between the ages of 7-17 Game Design, the Unreal Engine and Blueprinting, coding with C# in Unity, and video editing in Adobe Premiere. 

Lead team oriented activities and projects for students work.

Created plans and set goals for students projects to ensure deadlines were met.

volunteerExperiences.description: I played the role of a UX Tester, and tested multiple games at Full Sail's UX Lab. My job was to bring up improvements and changes that could be made to help with gameplay or user experience. Completed extensive surveys regarding the design/gameplay for how my experience as the player was.
